items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: But I stayed with Lloyd for quite a little while. All of -- almost all of '56.

ctx.x: And he was with Lloyd Hunter?
Yeah, he played with Lloyd Hunter's band before he got with Horace.
Oh, I see. And you took his place, huh?

items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: No. No, I'd left Cleanhead's band. I left Cleanhead in St. Louis.

ctx.x: Well, that was your first session.
So then, the next sessions were with Cleanhead, I guess, huh?
Well, maybe with Cleanhead. No, I could have been with Cleanhead. No, no, I was doing record dates with other groups around New York.

items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: We all called him Dry Hat.

ctx.x: We all called him Dry Hat.
